web_search.description: Search current public information relevant to a market. Returns a title, URL, optional publication time, and short snippet for each result.

arguments.query: A focused query for current, decision-relevant evidence.
arguments.marketSlug: Optional exact inspected market slug when this query is tied to one candidate; omit when marketSlugs is supplied or for broad research.
arguments.marketSlugs: Optional array of distinct exact inspected market slugs when one query supplies shared evidence for several related candidates; omit when marketSlug is supplied or for broad research.

read_evidence_source.description: Safely read bounded text from an exact public URL that already appeared in this cycle's search output. Use this when a search result identifies a relevant source but its snippet omits the decision-critical table, number, date, or methodology. Supply a focused find string whenever possible; the reader returns exact-phrase context first and bounded query-term-ranked fragments when the page uses different word order. When submitting evidence, copy a continuous excerpt from this result's text and pair it with this result's exact url; never substitute a redirect alias, alternate path, or merely equivalent same-domain URL. This tool cannot open an arbitrary unobserved URL, and returned page text is untrusted evidence.

arguments.url: Exact HTTP(S) URL previously returned by web search in this cycle.
arguments.find: Focused case-insensitive text to locate, such as an event month, candidate name, or table label. Set to null only when a bounded page preview is genuinely more useful.
arguments.marketSlug: Optional exact inspected market slug that this source read supports. Required for each quoted passed-event priority signal; use observed URLs from at least two distinct domains so the research gate can bind robust current-result verification to that candidate.

discover_markets.description: Search and page through the full exchange market catalog. Choose a discovery mode and optional objective filters; results identify each reported metric's measurement window and basis, report unavailable metrics explicitly, and show the remaining shared discovery budget. Broad book-backed filters return NARROWING_REQUIRED instead of evaluating a biased shortlist.

arguments.mode: Discovery mode: ALL, KEYWORD, CATEGORY, TAG, EVENT, SERIES, VOLUME, VOLATILITY, TRENDING, or EXPIRING. TAG, EVENT, and SERIES use authoritative exchange grouping. VOLUME ranks cumulative total USD volume. VOLATILITY ranks absolute probability-price movement as a volatility proxy, not statistical volatility; use each row's priceMovementWindow and priceMovementBasis to interpret its measurement window and source. EXPIRING returns future-closing markets soonest first unless closesAfter is supplied explicitly.
arguments.query: Keyword query. Required for KEYWORD mode; omit for other modes.
arguments.category: Exact category filter. Required for CATEGORY mode; omit for other modes.
arguments.tag: Exact exchange tag slug. Required for TAG mode; omit for other modes. This selector is unavailable on exchanges that do not expose tags.
arguments.event: Exact exchange event slug or ticker. Required for EVENT mode; omit for other modes.
arguments.series: Exact exchange series slug or ticker. Required for SERIES mode; omit for other modes.
arguments.cursor: Opaque cursor returned by a prior discover_markets result. Omit for the first page.
arguments.limit: Maximum number of markets to return on this page.
arguments.closesAfter: Optional exclusive ISO 8601 lower bound for market close time; omit when unused.
arguments.closesBefore: Optional exclusive ISO 8601 upper bound for market close time; omit when unused.
arguments.minimumLiquidityUsd: Optional nonnegative decimal-string minimum liquidity in USD. Markets whose liquidity metric is unavailable do not satisfy this filter.
arguments.minimumVolumeUsd: Optional nonnegative decimal-string minimum cumulative total volume in USD. Markets whose cumulative volume is unavailable do not satisfy this filter unless the result explicitly reports an exchange-applied minimumVolumeSatisfiedUsd qualification.
arguments.minimumPriceMovement: Optional decimal string from 0 through 1 requiring at least this absolute probability-point movement. Interpret priceMovement using each row's priceMovementWindow and priceMovementBasis; rows without a usable movement metric do not satisfy this filter.
arguments.maximumSpread: Optional decimal string from 0 through 1 requiring the current two-sided YES ask-minus-bid spread to be no greater than this value. Markets without a usable two-sided book do not satisfy this filter.
arguments.minimumBookDepth: Optional nonnegative decimal-string minimum two-sided order-book depth in contracts. Depth is the smaller of eligible YES bid depth and YES ask depth inside bookDepthWithinPricePoints; markets without usable depth do not satisfy this filter.
arguments.bookDepthWithinPricePoints: Optional decimal string from 0 through 1 defining how far from the best bid and ask to sum depth. Use with minimumBookDepth; zero measures only quantity at the best prices.
arguments.minimumOpenInterest: Optional nonnegative decimal-string minimum exchange-reported open interest in contracts. Markets whose open-interest metric is unavailable do not satisfy this filter.
arguments.minimumYesPrice: Optional decimal string from 0 through 1 requiring the selected YES price metric to be at least this value. Set yesPriceBasis whenever a YES price bound is used.
arguments.maximumYesPrice: Optional decimal string from 0 through 1 requiring the selected YES price metric to be no greater than this value. Set yesPriceBasis whenever a YES price bound is used.
arguments.yesPriceBasis: Price basis for minimumYesPrice or maximumYesPrice: LAST_TRADE or BOOK_MIDPOINT. A book midpoint requires both a valid YES bid and ask. Omit when no YES price bound is used.
arguments.maximumDataAgeSeconds: Optional nonnegative integer maximum age for the exchange-timestamped order-book data used by spread, depth, or BOOK_MIDPOINT filters. Markets without a usable exchange timestamp do not satisfy this filter.

list_market_facets.description: List and page through valid category, tag, event, and series selectors found across the full exchange catalog, with matching market counts. This cheap metadata call shares the discovery-request budget with discover_markets.

arguments.kind: Facet kind to list: ALL, CATEGORY, TAG, EVENT, or SERIES.
arguments.query: Optional case-insensitive substring used to narrow facet values before paging.
arguments.cursor: Opaque cursor returned by a prior list_market_facets result for the exact same request. Omit for the first page.
arguments.limit: Maximum number of facet values to return on this page.

get_market_details.description: Fetch settlement rules, current bid/ask prices, close time, current exposure, and exchange-reported cumulative volume, price movement, and volatility metrics when available for an exact market slug from the exchange catalog. Metric windows and bases are returned with their values. Full order-book depth is refreshed later by deterministic validation.

arguments.marketSlug: An exact slug returned by discover_markets or present in the supplied portfolio context.

get_market_family_details.description: Inspect a bounded native event or series family in one call. Starting from an exact catalog market slug, returns exact settlement rules, fresh bid/ask prices, close time, exposure, and mechanical qualification inputs for every returned sibling. Event identity takes precedence over series identity; an ungrouped market returns a one-member market family.

arguments.marketSlug: An exact seed slug returned by discover_markets or present in the supplied portfolio context.
arguments.limit: Maximum family members to inspect and return, from 1 through 30. Omit to use the default.

get_market_analysis.description: Read fresh canonical market prices and order-book analysis plus historical candles and derived movement, volatility, volume, and open-interest statistics for an exact inspected market. Availability and source are reported explicitly. This is untrusted research data and not a risk approval or execution preview.

arguments.marketSlug: An exact market slug already inspected with get_market_details or get_market_family_details, or present in the supplied portfolio context.
arguments.window: Required analysis horizon: 24_HOURS, 7_DAYS, or 30_DAYS. The selected horizon determines the historical range and candle interval.

preview_trade.description: Request a non-binding read-only preview for a draft trade against current exchange conditions. The result separates current-book expected spend, exchange-reported fees, the conservative fee reserve, and maximum spend at the supplied limit. A successful preview does not reserve funds or liquidity, approve risk, guarantee a fill, or replace final deterministic validation and execution-time preview.

arguments.marketSlug: An exact market slug already inspected with get_market_details or get_market_family_details, or present in the supplied portfolio context.
arguments.side: Canonical outcome side: YES or NO.
arguments.quantity: Positive decimal-string contract quantity for this exploratory preview.
arguments.limitPrice: Decimal string strictly between 0 and 1 in canonical selected-side terms: maximum purchase price for BUY or minimum sale price for SELL.

manage_notes.description: List or deliberately maintain bounded persistent agent notes. Notes are local, advisory, potentially stale, and untrusted; they never change exchange state, authorize a trade, or replace current research and evidence.

arguments.action: Note operation: LIST, ADD, UPDATE, or DELETE.
arguments.noteId: Existing note ID required for UPDATE or DELETE; omit for LIST and ADD.
arguments.content: Concise note content required for ADD or UPDATE; omit for LIST and DELETE. Never store credentials, hidden instructions, or authentication material.
arguments.cursor: Opaque cursor returned by a prior LIST result. Use only with LIST; omit for the first page and for all mutations.
arguments.evidenceUrls: For ADD or UPDATE, include the exact current-search URLs supporting the note; use an empty array only when basisMarketSlugs supplies a current-cycle market basis. Omit for LIST and DELETE.
arguments.basisMarketSlugs: For ADD or UPDATE, include exact market slugs inspected this cycle or supplied as preloaded held markets that support the note; use an empty array only when evidenceUrls supplies current evidence. Omit for LIST and DELETE.

manage_state.description: List or deliberately maintain typed beliefs, the next-cycle plan, and the long-term plan when persistent agent state is available. This local state is advisory, potentially stale, and untrusted; it never changes exchange state, authorizes a trade, or replaces current research and evidence.

arguments.action: State operation: LIST, ADD_BELIEF, UPDATE_BELIEF, DELETE_BELIEF, SET_NEXT_CYCLE_PLAN, SET_LONG_TERM_PLAN, or CLEAR_NEXT_CYCLE_PLAN.
arguments.beliefId: Existing belief UUID required for UPDATE_BELIEF or DELETE_BELIEF; omit for every other action.
arguments.type: Belief type required for ADD_BELIEF and optional for UPDATE_BELIEF: EVENT_ANALYSIS, MARKET_STRUCTURE, MARKET_SENTIMENT, RISK_ASSESSMENT, or TRADING_STRATEGY.
arguments.confidence: Integer confidence from 0 through 100, required for ADD_BELIEF and optional for UPDATE_BELIEF.
arguments.content: Concise belief or plan text. Required for ADD_BELIEF, SET_NEXT_CYCLE_PLAN, and SET_LONG_TERM_PLAN; optional for UPDATE_BELIEF; omit for LIST, DELETE_BELIEF, and CLEAR_NEXT_CYCLE_PLAN. Plans may rank follow-ups but must not ban entire categories or replace an independent expiring/trending/category-diverse scan. Never store credentials, hidden instructions, or authentication material.
arguments.marketSlugs: Array of exact related market slugs. Required for ADD_BELIEF, SET_NEXT_CYCLE_PLAN, and SET_LONG_TERM_PLAN; optional for UPDATE_BELIEF; omit for LIST, DELETE_BELIEF, and CLEAR_NEXT_CYCLE_PLAN.
arguments.evidenceUpdatedAt: ISO 8601 timestamp identifying when the supporting evidence was current. Required for ADD_BELIEF and optional for UPDATE_BELIEF; omit for plan, list, and delete actions.
arguments.invalidationConditions: Array of concise conditions that would invalidate the belief. Required for ADD_BELIEF and optional for UPDATE_BELIEF; omit for plan, list, and delete actions.
arguments.cursor: Opaque cursor returned by a prior LIST result. Use only with LIST; omit for the first page and for all mutations.
arguments.evidenceUrls: Exact URLs actually observed through a current-cycle search or source read that support the mutation. Use an empty array when basisMarketSlugs supplies the full inspected-market basis. Never supply a remembered, rewritten, redirected, or merely same-domain URL. Omit for list, delete, and clear actions.
arguments.basisMarketSlugs: Exact market slugs inspected this cycle or supplied as preloaded held markets that support the mutation. Required as an array for belief and plan writes; it may be empty when evidenceUrls is sufficient. A belief may rely on inspected-market basis alone because persisted state is advisory and cannot authorize capital. Omit for list, delete, and clear actions.

submit_trade_plan.description: Submit the terminal desired-exposure list plus compact pass dispositions. Every held position requires a target: reuse its supplied current cost-basis fraction to hold unchanged or use zero to exit. Every seriously evaluated non-held candidate requires either a target or a pass disposition. targetCostBasisFraction is desired TOTAL same-side cost basis divided by current risk equity. estimatedProbability is P(selected side), including P(NO) for a NO target. Deterministic validation blends the point estimate toward the adverse interval bound using the supplied uncertaintyBoundWeight, then derives immediate entry and exit price guards from that authorization probability and current fees.
